    line = input()

    result = 0
    last_char = line[0]
    toggle = False

    for i in range(1, len(line)):

        if i == len(line) - 1 and line[i] == last_char and toggle:

        if line[i] != last_char:
            last_char = line[i]
            result += 0 if toggle else 1
            toggle = False

    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
